get.description: Retrieves due rewards from Referral Factory by metric.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Due reward dashboard metric to retrieve.

schema.description: Due reward dashboard metric to retrieve.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

can_be_issued.description: Whether the due reward can be issued.

count.description: Reward count when the reward metric is not coupon.

coupon.description: Coupon code when the reward metric is coupon.

total.description: Reward total when the reward metric is not coupon.
